designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system expresses the intersection of aspiring technical competence and soft, approachable warmth. Created for a female Software Engineering vocational student (Siswi XI RPL SMKN 6 Surakarta), it avoids cold, sterile developer tropes in favor of an airy, welcoming aesthetic that remains rigorously structured and legible.

The visual mood blends modern glassmorphism and tactile softness: clean white elevated surfaces, gentle blush tints, smooth pastel glows, and graceful curves. The emotional tone evokes youthful ambition, discipline, precision, and authentic charm—making school projects, engineering skills, and personal milestones feel both delightful and professional to potential internship recruiters, educators, and peers.

## Layout & Spacing

The portfolio is structured on a 12-column responsive grid (max-width `1200px`) centered over the pastel canvas. On mobile screens, it naturally collapses into a unified 4-column flow with reduced gutters and edge margins.

- **Grid Behavior**: Desktop spans multiple column arrangements (e.g., 4-col sidebar with 8-col project stream; 3-col project showcase cards). Tablets collapse into a 2-column card layout, while smartphones adopt a stacked 1-column hierarchy.
- **Rhythm**: Component interiors prioritize comfortable internal breathing room, utilizing `space-lg` (`1.5rem`) for standard card padding and `space-xl` (`2.5rem`) for section delineation.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual depth avoids harsh grays, relying instead on diffused, rosy light and subtle translucency:

- **Ambient Pink Glow (Level 1)**: `0 4px 20px -2px rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.12)`, paired with an ultra-thin border `1px solid rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.22)`. Standard for resting cards and profile modules.
- **Hover / Focus Lift (Level 2)**: `0 12px 30px -4px rgba(219, 39, 119, 0.18)`, with an increased border highlight `1px solid rgba(219, 39, 119, 0.35)`. Translates elements -2px on the Y-axis.
- **Glass Floating Navigation**: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)` surface with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and a subtle bottom border `1px solid rgba(252, 231, 243, 0.9)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid `#DB2777` fill with white text, pill-shaped (`rounded-full`), padded `0.75rem 1.5rem`. On hover: lifts 2px with an enriched `#BE185D` background and `rgba(219, 39, 119, 0.25)` drop shadow.
- **Secondary / Ghost**: White background `#FFFFFF`, text `#DB2777`, border `1px solid #FCE7F3`. On hover: transitions to `#FDF2F4` fill with `#F472B6` border.

### Chips & Badges
- **Tech Stack Chips**: Background `#FCE7F3`, text `#DB2777`, font `JetBrains Mono` (`label-sm`), padding `0.25rem 0.75rem`, rounded `9999px`. 
- **Status Indicator**: Glowing pastel dot (e.g., active for student internship / "Available for PKL") with pulsing ring animation.

### Cards & Project Showcases
- White base (`#FFFFFF`) framed in `1px solid rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.25)`, `rounded-2xl` (1.25rem), with Level 1 rosy shadow.
- Inner layout features an image preview container with rounded top corners, followed by tech chips, project title in `#1F2937`, descriptive text in `#374151`, and a clean link button.

### Form Inputs & Contact Fields
- Fill `#FFFFFF`, border `1.5px solid #FCE7F3`, rounded `1rem`, text `#1F2937`.
- Focus state triggers an immediate soft glow `box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.2)` with a `#DB2777` stroke.

### Specialized Elements
- **Student Profile Hero**: Dual-layer circular avatar ring with `#FCE7F3` and `#DB2777` accents, housing school affiliations ("SMKN 6 Surakarta - Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak") alongside social and GitHub repository links.
- **Skill Progress Bar**: Track in `#FCE7F3`, fill in linear gradient from `#F472B6` to `#DB2777`, rounded `9999px`.

## Brand & Style

This design system expresses the intersection of aspiring technical competence and soft, approachable warmth. Created for a female Software Engineering vocational student (Siswi XI RPL SMKN 6 Surakarta), it avoids cold, sterile developer tropes in favor of an airy, welcoming aesthetic that remains rigorously structured and legible.

The visual mood blends modern glassmorphism and tactile softness: clean white elevated surfaces, gentle blush tints, smooth pastel glows, and graceful curves. The emotional tone evokes youthful ambition, discipline, precision, and authentic charm—making school projects, engineering skills, and personal milestones feel both delightful and professional to potential internship recruiters, educators, and peers.

## Colors

The palette balances soft strawberry and sakura tones against high-contrast charcoal neutrals to safeguard accessibility and code readability:

- **Primary (`#DB2777`)**: Deep Rose / Magenta. Used for key interactive actions, focused states, prominent links, and emphasized hero metrics.
- **Secondary (`#F472B6`)**: Soft Rose. Applied to badges, active highlight strokes, progress bars, and glowing interactive hover states.
- **Tertiary (`#FCE7F3`)**: Pastel Blush. Serves as container fills, chip backings, and subtle boundary tints.
- **Neutral Core**:
  - Headings & Primary Text: `#1F2937` (Charcoal Slate) for crisp legibility.
  - Body Copy: `#374151` (Medium Slate).
  - Secondary / Muted Text: `#9CA3AF` (Soft Cool Gray).
- **Surface Foundations**:
  - Page Canvas: `#FDF2F4` (Delicate Rose Alabaster).
  - Elevated Cards & Sheets: `#FFFFFF` (Pure White).
  - Subtle Borders: `#FCE7F3` with optional 1px translucent overlays (`rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.2)`).

## Typography

Typography pairs **Plus Jakarta Sans** for clear, open, friendly editorial layouts with **JetBrains Mono** for technical accents, metadata, tech stack tags (e.g., `Laravel`, `React`, `MySQL`), and student credentials (e.g., `NISN / RPL-6`).

- **Plus Jakarta Sans** conveys youthfulness without losing professional poise, utilizing relaxed geometries and high legibility.
- **JetBrains Mono** roots the portfolio firmly in software craftsmanship, contrasting softly against rounded pink elements.
- Tight negative tracking (`-0.03em`) on major headlines anchors visual prominence, while body copy retains breathable line-height for effortless reading.

## Layout & Spacing

The portfolio is structured on a 12-column responsive grid (max-width `1200px`) centered over the pastel canvas. On mobile screens, it naturally collapses into a unified 4-column flow with reduced gutters and edge margins.

- **Grid Behavior**: Desktop spans multiple column arrangements (e.g., 4-col sidebar with 8-col project stream; 3-col project showcase cards). Tablets collapse into a 2-column card layout, while smartphones adopt a stacked 1-column hierarchy.
- **Rhythm**: Component interiors prioritize comfortable internal breathing room, utilizing `space-lg` (`1.5rem`) for standard card padding and `space-xl` (`2.5rem`) for section delineation.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual depth avoids harsh grays, relying instead on diffused, rosy light and subtle translucency:

- **Ambient Pink Glow (Level 1)**: `0 4px 20px -2px rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.12)`, paired with an ultra-thin border `1px solid rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.22)`. Standard for resting cards and profile modules.
- **Hover / Focus Lift (Level 2)**: `0 12px 30px -4px rgba(219, 39, 119, 0.18)`, with an increased border highlight `1px solid rgba(219, 39, 119, 0.35)`. Translates elements -2px on the Y-axis.
- **Glass Floating Navigation**: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)` surface with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and a subtle bottom border `1px solid rgba(252, 231, 243, 0.9)`.

## Shapes

The design system embraces a high-radius curve style (`rounded-2xl` / `1rem` to `1.5rem`) across structural modules to reinforce softness and gentleness:

- **Cards & Hero Containers**: Use `1.25rem` (20px) to `1.5rem` (24px) corner radii.
- **Buttons & Tags**: Retain pill profiles (`rounded-full` / `9999px`) to emphasize touch-friendliness and playfulness.
- **Thumbnails & Avatars**: Profile photography and software screenshots utilize smooth `1rem` (16px) corners, framed by a 3px pure white border and soft pink drop glow.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid `#DB2777` fill with white text, pill-shaped (`rounded-full`), padded `0.75rem 1.5rem`. On hover: lifts 2px with an enriched `#BE185D` background and `rgba(219, 39, 119, 0.25)` drop shadow.
